prompt: Generate ONE square 4x4 sheet of sixteen FREE-FLOATING MAGIC EFFECTS on a single perfectly uniform pure magenta #FF00FF background. No cards, rectangles, panels or grid lines: the same magenta goes inside all empty holes and between all particles. Effects are raw painted energy, NOT objects or icons. No metal rims, arrowheads, stones forming circular frames, physical shields or borders. Four rows: fire embers/flame; water liquid/mist/droplets; earth loose angular stone motes/dust; air wind/lightning. Four columns: a small narrow energy projectile with bright core and short trail; compact impact burst; low broken aura swirl viewed from high oblique camera; thin open crescent of energy, rear visibly empty. Original dark fantasy hand-painted VFX with rich organic detail, no cartoon outline, no grain, no paper. Each motif fits within the central 65 percent of its cell with generous blank magenta around it. Keep colours amber, icy blue, ochre and silver-lilac respectively; no magenta in effect pigments. No text, labels, characters, floor or shadows. Bright cores and sparse particles, not a blurry opaque cloud.
